# Third-party code

`qrcode-generator.min.js` is qrcode-generator 1.4.4 by Kazuhiko Arase, MIT licence, downloaded
unmodified from
https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/qrcode-generator/1.4.4/qrcode.min.js
(project: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator).

It is kept here rather than loaded from a CDN so that the poster page works with nothing but this
site, and so that a gym's join code - which is in the page's address - is never sent to a third
party as a referrer.
